note: Why a personality decision did not run, or ran without personality turning it, in the October 20, 2026 audit (docs/reports/trait-wiring-2026-10-20.md). One row per decision with a gap; the matrix (scripts/traits/trait-wiring-matrix.ts) joins them. A row is removed when its fix lands.

corruption.offer.why: Runs about 4 times a year (a lobbyist's first meeting with a member on a bill with employer costs, src/core2/modules/interest-groups.ts:372); the yes score never beats corruptionHonestPull 3, so every offer is declined and the trait never turns one.
corruption.offer.fix: Weigh the stake against the official's own money need and calibrate the honesty pull from the honesty-humility effect size.

corruption.take.class: trigger needs a record nobody writes
corruption.take.why: Runs only after an offer says yes (src/core2/modules/corruption.ts:177); no offer did.

corruption.tell.class: trigger needs a record nobody writes
corruption.tell.why: Needs a taken bribe's crime row (src/core2/modules/corruption.ts:215); none was written.

justice.report.class: trigger needs a record nobody writes
justice.report.why: Needs a crime row from corruption (src/core2/modules/justice.ts:250); ran twice from other crimes.

justice.prosecute.class: trigger needs a record nobody writes

justice.plea.class: trigger needs a record nobody writes

press.tip.class: trigger needs a record nobody writes
press.tip.why: Needs a crime.told event for a taken bribe (src/core2/modules/press.ts:2049).

recalls.organize.why: Only a county or city ordinance taking effect starts one, and only where the state allows recall without grounds (src/core2/modules/recalls.ts:159, :190); most places have no petition recall or require grounds.
recalls.organize.fix: Let a reported scandal or crime start a for-cause recall where the state requires grounds.

recalls.vote.why: Needs a recall on the ballot (src/core2/modules/recalls.ts:380).

ballot-measures.vote.class: runs only on a date outside the year
ballot-measures.vote.why: The earliest measure in data/elections/ballot-measures.json is June 16, 2026; the audit year ends January 20, 2026. The decision runs in a November 2026 count (src/core2/modules/ballot-measures.traits.test.ts), not in the audit year.
ballot-measures.vote.fix: Add odd-year measures or let an ordinance refer a local measure.

voting.stand-again.class: runs only on a date outside the year

campaigns.open-door.class: runs only on a date outside the year
campaigns.open-door.why: Needs a filed, on-ballot race (src/core2/modules/campaigns.ts:2323); filings opened in 1 of 3 places measured.

campaigns.donate.class: runs only on a date outside the year

campaigns.rival-hours.class: runs only on a date outside the year

campaigns.answer-poll.class: runs only on a date outside the year
campaigns.answer-poll.why: Same as campaigns.open-door, plus a poll fund (src/core2/modules/campaigns.ts:2253).

campaigns.retell.class: runs only on a date outside the year

campaigns.volunteer.why: Only the bench's developer call asks (src/bench/campaign.ts:168); a world candidate never asks anyone to volunteer.
campaigns.volunteer.fix: In campaignTurn, ask reachable people to volunteer as it asks for donations.

campaigns.endorse.why: Only the bench's developer call asks (src/bench/campaign.ts:182).
campaigns.endorse.fix: In campaignTurn, ask the people closest to the candidate for endorsements.

offices.accept-appointment.why: Runs only when a serving local official dies or moves away and the post fills by appointment (src/core2/modules/offices.ts:1067).
offices.accept-appointment.fix: Add resignation as a vacancy cause.

constituent-cases.handle-case.class: no trigger (staff takes the case first)
constituent-cases.handle-case.why: A staffer's decision is tried first (src/core2/modules/constituent-cases.ts:451), so the official's own read never runs where an official has staff.
constituent-cases.handle-case.fix: Let the official's own lean set what the staffer is told.

conversation.reply-reach.why: Read only in a conversation the player opens.
conversation.reply-reach.fix: Player-only by design; covered by the player's conversations.

bring-it-up.blame.why: Read only in a conversation the player opens (src/director/bring-it-up.ts:105).

press.accept-interview.class: runs only on a date outside the year
press.accept-interview.why: Interviews are scheduled only within weeks of an election (src/core2/modules/press.ts:2460).

press.dig.class: runs only on a date outside the year
press.dig.why: Follows an interview answer that contradicts a record (src/core2/modules/press.ts:1753).

estates.will.why: Runs when someone with an estate dies (src/core2/estates.ts:283).

office-day-state.leader-request.why: Only the bench path check calls it (src/bench/path-check.ts:236).
office-day-state.leader-request.fix: Have a legislator who drafted a bill ask the leader for a hearing in doEntry.

office-day-state.clemency.why: A weekly clemency petition for a governor who is not the player is in review on another branch.

housing.buy-home.why: Runs at the housing review but every household keeps renting (the buy baseline and down-payment terms outweigh any lean).
housing.buy-home.fix: Calibrate the buy reasons so some households buy, then the trait weight.

jobs.apply.why: Ran 545 times; the pick never changed with personality.

jobs.review-worker.why: Ran 2,059 times; the pick never changed with personality.

drives.respond.why: Ran 1,471 times; the pick never changed with personality in this place.

legislature.attend-sitting.why: Personality turned 96 of 100 picks: attending and missing score almost the same without it, so the trait term settles nearly every sitting (src/core2/modules/legislature.ts:2516).
legislature.attend-sitting.fix: Add the member's duty reasons and calibrate the weight from attendance research.
